title: PO-HRL: Partial-Order Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
description: Code, tests, notebooks, data, result logs and analysis scripts for 'When Does Order Matter? Partial-Order Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models'. Includes an order-theoretic library (posets, ideals, linear extensions, exact precedence Shapley and Owen credit), a language-model pipeline for planning, round-based execution, step verification and LoRA training with flat, chain, random-order chain and poset credit (and an experimental local-credit option for follow-up work), the controlled experiments, the synthetic multi-part data set, and every result file used in the paper.
